04 / The bookshelf

Beyond
the code.

What fills the hours away from the keyboard, and the habits of mind I bring back to every product.

Hobbies

  • ReadingBooks keep me curious beyond the screen and patient with long problems.
  • GamingGood games are good product design: clear goals, fast feedback, fair difficulty.
  • SportsTime away from the screen that keeps my head clear for the next build.
  • Tech researchTrying new tools, frameworks and AI models early, then keeping only what earns its place.

Soft skills

  • Critical thinkingQuestion the brief, check the data and separate signal from opinion before building.
  • Problem solvingBreak a fuzzy problem into the smallest complete loop that can ship and be measured.
  • System designChoose the simplest architecture that can carry the product, like a 12-schema PostgreSQL modular monolith.
  • Product Owner · Business AnalystTurn business goals into prioritised hypotheses, clear requirements and acceptance criteria.
